welcomeMessage: I'm the FandomVerse guide. Ask about characters, events, trailers or merchandise — or pick one of the shortcuts below.
defaultFallback: I don't have an answer for that one. I can help with characters, events, trailers, merchandise, or finding your way around a world.

rules.response: Hello. You're in {world}. Ask me about its characters, events, trailers or merchandise.

FandomVerse is a browser-only portal for seven fandom worlds — anime, gaming, movies, TV shows, K-pop, comics and manga. Every character, story and product here is original fiction written and drawn for this portal.
Seven worlds: Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics and Manga. Each has its own lead character, events, trailers and merchandise.
{world} has its own cast, led by {lead}. You'll find every character file on the {world} hub.
Events for {world} — meetups, premieres and community gatherings — are listed on the {world} hub, and everything across all seven worlds is on the Events page.
Trailers are demonstrative listings for original fictional franchises — there's no video to play. You can browse every one on the Trailers page.
Merchandise for {world} is on the Merchandise page. Everything is an original FandomVerse product — this is a demonstration catalogue, not a real storefront, so nothing can actually be purchased.
Start on the {world} hub: the lead character sits at the top, then featured stories, events, trailers and merchandise below. The header navigates between all seven worlds.
Use the search control in the header — it searches articles, characters and events across every world.
Bookmarks are saved in your browser for this session and listed on the Bookmarks page. Nothing is sent anywhere — FandomVerse has no server.
None of it is real. FandomVerse is a student/competition project: the franchises, characters and products are original fiction, and the store is a demonstration only.
I'm a local guide — no network, no AI service, just a small rule set running in your browser. I can point you to characters, events, trailers, merchandise and search.
